source._comment: Michigan has NO party registration -> turnout-only. The MI SoS Voter Participation Dashboard (Power BI, app.powerbigov.us) publishes absentee/early voting counts by county, updated daily starting 45 days before Election Day (~Sept 19 2026). MI does not distinguish mail vs in-person early in its data. Public access is the Power BI dashboard; the raw weekday county file has no public URL. STAGED SKELETON: writes 0 until a verified live feed is wired (the Friday rollout routine captures the Power BI querydata endpoint / county file in Oct). Turnout-only: 'cast' = ballots cast; the map shades by turnout %.
